description: Homescoope recipes pin upstream library versions in packages/*/recipe.yaml.
A custom regex manager reads `# renovate: …` comments above `version:` and opens one PR per package when upstream cuts a release.
Recipe automerge only for packages listed in scripts/ci-certified.json (full cert/*.mjs checklist + negative proof). Majors and new packages stay manual.

customManagers.description: Homebrew-shaped recipe.yaml upstream pins (see # renovate comments).

packageRules.description: Default: recipe bumps do not automerge until CI-certified.
Semver majors on recipes: always human (Lars).
CI-certified packages (see scripts/ci-certified.json) — non-major only. Synced by scripts/sync-ci-certified-renovate.mjs.
libpng 1.7 is a parallel beta line; stay on the 1.6.x stable series.
vim tags move fast; xxd tracks a pinned patch — ignore majors.
Workflow action pins below a major.
github-script major bumps can break ladder-merge; review by hand.
cmake: build.sh relinks a prebuilt slicc-emscripten cmake-wasm-build tree that CI does not have, so a Renovate bump can never go green (#30). Off until cmake is CI-buildable.

py-* C++ side modules (numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, contourpy, kiwisolver): upstream bumps need a wasix side-module rebuild on the current sysroot runtimes and move the whole numpy C-API stack together; they ride homescoop#211 (py-* C++ stack v2), not single-package Renovate PRs (#31, #32, #38). Re-pins onto a new wasix-python are packaging-only repacks.

Retired recipes (builder: retired): no Renovate PRs. They are built, if at all, by their own workflows from pinned sources (e.g. wasi-rustc-stable.yml), so a recipe bump builds nothing. Synced by scripts/sync-ci-certified-renovate.mjs.
